title: Filipino Chicken Inasal
summary: Chargrilled chicken marinated in calamansi-style citrus, vinegar, garlic and lemongrass with a golden annatto glaze.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Pound lemongrass and garlic, then combine with lime juice, vinegar and soy sauce.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Coat chicken and refrigerate for at least one hour, turning once.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Heat a grill to medium and cook chicken, turning regularly, until browned and fully cooked.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Brush with paprika-infused oil near the end, rest five minutes and serve with rice.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Use a thermometer to confirm the thickest part reaches 75°C.
variations: Roast in the oven when grilling is not possible.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Argentinian Chimichurri Steak
summary: Juicy grilled steak sliced against the grain and topped with punchy parsley, garlic and red-wine-vinegar chimichurri.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Chop parsley and garlic finely, then stir with vinegar, oil, oregano and chilli.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Pat steak dry, season generously with salt and leave at room temperature briefly.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Sear in a hot heavy pan until browned and cooked to your preferred doneness.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest for ten minutes, slice against the grain and spoon over chimichurri.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Resting the steak keeps more juices in each slice.
variations: Use coriander alongside parsley for a different herb profile.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Japanese Okonomiyaki
summary: Savoury cabbage pancakes with crisp edges, tender centres and a drizzle of tangy sauce and mayonnaise.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Shred cabbage finely and slice spring onions, keeping the vegetables dry.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk flour, eggs and dashi into a thick batter, then fold in the cabbage.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook thick pancakes in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat until golden on both sides and cooked through.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise, then slice into wedges.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Avoid pressing the pancakes flat while cooking.
variations: Add cooked prawns or diced bacon to the batter.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Brazilian Moqueca
summary: Tender white fish gently poached in a fragrant coconut, tomato and pepper stew with lime and coriander.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Season fish chunks with lime and salt and refrigerate while preparing vegetables.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften sliced onion, garlic and pepper in olive oil, then add chopped tomatoes.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour in coconut milk and simmer gently until the vegetables are tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Nestle fish into sauce, cover and poach until opaque and flaky; finish with coriander.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Keep the stew at a gentle simmer so the fish stays intact.
variations: Add prawns during the final few minutes.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: South African Bobotie
summary: Curried minced beef baked beneath a golden savoury egg custard with raisins and warming spices.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Soak bread in half the milk, then squeeze lightly and reserve the liquid.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften onion, brown beef and stir in curry powder, raisins, chutney and soaked bread.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Transfer the spiced meat to a baking dish and smooth the surface.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Beat eggs with remaining milk, pour over meat, add bay leaves and bake at 180°C until set.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Let the baked custard settle before slicing.
variations: Swap raisins for chopped dried apricots.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Turkish Lahmacun
summary: Thin crisp flatbreads topped with warmly spiced minced lamb, tomato, pepper and parsley, finished with lemon.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix flour, yeast and water into a soft dough, knead and let rise until slightly puffy.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Finely chop tomato, pepper, onion and parsley; mix with lamb and paprika.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Divide dough into thin rounds and spread a very thin layer of lamb mixture to the edges.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake on a preheated hot tray at 240°C until the base is crisp and meat cooked through.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: A thin topping helps the meat cook before the base burns.
variations: Use beef mince instead of lamb.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Spanish Gambas al Ajillo
summary: Juicy prawns sizzle in garlic-infused olive oil with chilli, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Pat prawns dry and slice garlic thinly so it cooks evenly.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Warm olive oil gently with garlic and chilli until fragrant but not browned.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Increase heat slightly, add prawns and cook briefly until pink and opaque.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter parsley over the pan and finish with lemon; serve immediately with bread.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Remove the pan from heat if garlic starts turning dark.
variations: Add a splash of dry sherry before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Italian Focaccia
summary: Fluffy olive-oil bread with a crisp golden crust, rosemary and flaky sea salt.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt and water into a sticky dough, then fold several times over thirty minutes.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Transfer to an oiled tray and leave to rise until airy and doubled in size.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Drizzle with olive oil and press fingertips deeply into the dough to form dimples.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter rosemary and salt over the top and bake at 220°C until golden and hollow sounding.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Wet or oil your hands to handle the sticky dough.
variations: Top with cherry tomatoes and olives.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Korean Gamja Jorim
summary: Tender baby potatoes glazed in a glossy sweet-salty soy sauce and finished with sesame seeds.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Halve larger potatoes and rinse to remove loose surface starch.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Pan-fry potatoes in oil until their edges begin to turn golden.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add water, soy sauce and mirin, then cover and simmer until tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Uncover, add honey and reduce liquid to a shiny glaze; sprinkle with sesame.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Shake the pan gently to coat without breaking potatoes.
variations: Add a pinch of gochugaru for warmth.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Moroccan Carrot Salad
summary: Tender carrots tossed with cumin, paprika, lemon, olive oil and fresh parsley.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Peel carrots and slice into even coins for consistent cooking.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer in lightly salted water until just tender, then drain well.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, cumin and paprika into a fragrant dressing.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss warm carrots with dressing and parsley; cool slightly before serving.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Dress carrots while warm so they absorb flavour.
variations: Add a little harissa for heat.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Turkish Simit
summary: Chewy sesame-crusted bread rings with a golden exterior, perfect with cheese, olives or tea.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt and water, then knead until smooth and elastic.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cover and let rise until doubled, then divide into eight pieces.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Roll dough into ropes, twist pairs together and join into rings.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Dip rings in diluted molasses, coat with sesame and bake at 220°C until deeply golden.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Toast sesame seeds lightly for extra aroma.
variations: Serve with labneh and sliced tomatoes.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Turkish Cilbir
summary: Silky poached eggs over garlicky yoghurt with warm paprika butter and fresh dill.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Bring yoghurt to room temperature and mix with finely grated garlic and salt.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Melt butter gently, add paprika and remove from heat before it burns.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Poach eggs in barely simmering water with vinegar until whites set.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spread yoghurt onto plates, add drained eggs and drizzle with paprika butter and dill.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Avoid boiling the poaching water, which can break the eggs.
variations: Use chilli flakes in the butter for heat.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Vietnamese Bun Cha
summary: Caramelised pork patties with rice vermicelli, fresh herbs and a tangy fish-sauce dipping broth.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix pork with minced garlic, a little fish sauce and sugar; form small patties.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Grill or pan-sear patties until browned and fully cooked through.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook vermicelli, rinse briefly and arrange with mint and shredded carrot.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Mix remaining fish sauce, lime, sugar and warm water into a dipping broth and serve alongside.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Grill pork in batches to encourage caramelisation.
variations: Use thin pork shoulder slices alongside patties.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Italian Caprese Panini
summary: Toasted ciabatta layered with creamy mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, basil and a little pesto.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice ciabatta and spread pesto evenly across the cut surfaces.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Pat mozzarella dry and slice tomatoes so the sandwich does not become watery.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Layer mozzarella, tomato and basil leaves inside each roll.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Brush outsides with oil and toast in a panini press until golden and cheese softens.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Dry mozzarella thoroughly to keep the bread crisp.
variations: Add roasted peppers for extra sweetness.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Middle Eastern Mujadara
summary: Earthy lentils and rice topped with deeply caramelised onions, served with lemony yoghurt.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice onions and cook slowly in olive oil until dark golden and sweet.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer lentils until almost tender, then drain and reserve a little liquid.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook rice with lentils, cumin and enough water until fluffy and fully tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fluff gently, top with onions and serve with yoghurt mixed with lemon.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: The deeply browned onions provide most of the dish's flavour.
variations: Use bulgur instead of rice.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: British Ploughman's Lunch
summary: A rustic plate of mature cheddar, crusty bread, pickles, apple and crisp vegetables.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice cheddar into generous wedges and bring to room temperature briefly.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Wash radishes and cucumber, then cut into easy-to-eat pieces.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Slice apples just before serving to keep their colour and crunch.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Arrange bread, cheese, fruit, vegetables and pickles on a platter.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Choose a strong cheddar to balance the sharp pickles.
variations: Add a hard-boiled egg for extra protein.
storage: Best served immediately; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

title: Turkish Sutlac
summary: Creamy baked rice pudding with a delicate vanilla aroma and lightly caramelised tops.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Simmer rice in water until tender and most liquid has been absorbed.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add milk and sugar, then cook gently until rice is soft and mixture thickens.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Mix cornflour with a little cold milk and stir in, cooking until lightly creamy.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Divide into ramekins and grill briefly until tops are golden; chill before serving.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Stir regularly so milk does not catch on the pan.
variations: Sprinkle cinnamon over the chilled pudding.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Indian Gulab Jamun
summary: Soft milk-solid dumplings soaked in fragrant cardamom and rose syrup until tender and glossy.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Simmer sugar, water and crushed cardamom into a light syrup; keep warm.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix milk powder, flour, baking powder, ghee and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Shape small smooth balls and fry gently in medium-low oil until evenly golden.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drain briefly, immerse in warm syrup and soak until plump before serving.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Keep frying oil moderate so centres cook before exteriors darken.
variations: Add a few drops of rosewater to the syrup.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Japanese Dorayaki
summary: Fluffy golden pancake sandwiches filled with sweet red bean paste, a classic Japanese treat.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Whisk eggs, sugar and honey until smooth, then fold in flour and baking powder.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add water gradually to make a thick but pourable batter and rest briefly.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Cook small rounds in a lightly oiled pan until bubbles appear, then flip until golden.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Sandwich pairs with red bean paste and press edges gently together.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Use low-medium heat for evenly golden pancakes.
variations: Fill with chestnut paste for a variation.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Mexican Arroz con Leche
summary: Creamy cinnamon-scented rice pudding simmered with milk, vanilla and a little condensed milk.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse rice and simmer in water with cinnamon until almost tender.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add milk and orange zest and cook gently, stirring frequently.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Stir in condensed milk and vanilla and simmer until thick and creamy.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove cinnamon and zest, then serve warm or chilled with ground cinnamon.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Pudding thickens as it cools, so stop cooking while still slightly loose.
variations: Add raisins during the final simmer.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Italian Zabaglione
summary: Light, foamy egg-yolk custard whisked over gentle heat with sugar and sweet Marsala wine.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Place egg yolks and sugar in a heatproof bowl and whisk until pale.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Add Marsala gradually and set bowl over barely simmering water.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk continuously until thick, airy and warm, without allowing the eggs to scramble.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spoon immediately over berries in small glasses and serve.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Keep the bowl above, not touching, the simmering water.
variations: Use orange juice instead of Marsala for an alcohol-free version.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: American Key Lime Pie
summary: Tangy lime custard in a buttery biscuit crust topped with softly whipped cream.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Crush biscuits and mix with melted butter, then press firmly into a pie dish.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Bake crust at 175°C for ten minutes and cool slightly.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Whisk condensed milk, egg yolks, lime juice and zest, then pour into crust.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake until just set, chill thoroughly and top with whipped cream.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Chilling is essential for clean slices and a firm filling.
variations: Use lemon for a different citrus pie.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Greek Galaktoboureko
summary: Crisp buttered filo pastry enclosing creamy semolina custard, soaked in fragrant lemon syrup.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Simmer milk with semolina and half the sugar until thick, then cool slightly and beat in eggs.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Layer half the filo sheets in a buttered baking dish, brushing each with melted butter.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Spread custard evenly, cover with remaining buttered filo and score the top.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake at 180°C until golden, then pour cooled lemon syrup over the hot pastry.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Pour cool syrup over hot pastry to keep the filo crisp.
variations: Add orange zest to the custard.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Swedish Cinnamon Buns
summary: Soft cardamom-scented buns spiralled with buttery cinnamon sugar and finished with pearl sugar.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Mix flour, warm milk, yeast, half the sugar, cardamom and softened butter into a smooth dough.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Let rise until doubled, then roll into a large rectangle and spread with butter, cinnamon and sugar.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Roll tightly, slice into buns and proof on a lined tray until puffy.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C until golden and fragrant.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Avoid adding excess flour so the buns stay soft.
variations: Finish with a simple vanilla glaze.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Georgian Lobio
summary: Creamy red beans stewed with walnuts, coriander and garlic, served with crusty bread.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Cook onion slowly in olive oil until golden.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add beans, coriander and a splash of water; simmer until creamy.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Crush walnuts with garlic, fold into beans and serve warm.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Mash some beans to thicken naturally.
variations: Add pomegranate seeds.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Sri Lankan Dhal Curry
summary: Golden red lentils simmered in coconut milk with curry leaves, turmeric and toasted mustard seeds.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils and chop onion and chilli.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric and water until almost tender.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add coconut milk and cook gently until creamy.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over lentils.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Avoid boiling coconut milk vigorously.
variations: Add spinach near the end.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Persian Fesenjan
summary: Tender chicken braised in a dark, tangy walnut and pomegranate sauce with gentle cinnamon warmth.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Finely grind walnuts and dice onion.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown chicken and soften onion in the same pot.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add walnuts, stock and cinnamon; simmer until chicken is tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir in pomegranate molasses and reduce until glossy and thick.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Taste before adding extra molasses as brands vary.
variations: Use duck legs for a richer version.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Indonesian Soto Ayam
summary: Golden turmeric chicken soup with rice noodles, cabbage, lime and crisp fried shallots.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Crush ginger and garlic and shred cabbage.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer chicken with turmeric, aromatics and stock until cooked.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Shred chicken and cook noodles separately.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Divide noodles and cabbage into bowls, add chicken and hot broth, then squeeze lime.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Cook noodles separately to keep broth clear.
variations: Top with boiled eggs.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken Orzo
summary: Tender chicken and orzo simmered in lemony broth with oregano, spinach and a silky finish.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Dice onion and season chicken with oregano.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown chicken, then soften onion in the same pan.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add stock and orzo and simmer, stirring until pasta is tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold in spinach and lemon juice, then serve with sliced chicken.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Stir orzo frequently so it does not stick.
variations: Add crumbled feta.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Cuban Ropa Vieja
summary: Slow-braised shredded beef with sweet peppers, tomato, cumin and olives.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice peppers and onion and season beef.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Sear beef on all sides in a heavy pot.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add vegetables, tomatoes, cumin and stock; braise covered until fork tender.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Shred beef into sauce, add olives and reduce slightly.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.

tips: Chuck becomes tender only after a long gentle braise.
variations: Serve with black beans and rice.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; reheat thoroughly if served hot.

title: Nepalese Chicken Momo
summary: Steamed dumplings packed with ginger-scented chicken, spring onion and coriander.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Knead flour and water into dough and rest covered.
Prepare everything before heating the pan so the next stage moves smoothly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix chicken with chopped spring onion, ginger, garlic and soy.
Stir or check regularly to avoid uneven cooking.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Roll thin circles and pleat around spoonfuls of filling.
Check the texture and doneness before proceeding.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Steam until dough is translucent and chicken reaches a safe internal temperature.
Taste, adjust seasoning where appropriate and serve as directed.
